item.title: Adobe’s AI faces a copyright reality check
item.description: Adobe’s AI education may have involved a little too much “borrowed” reading material.

item.title: Meta tests a “Pay to Link” option on Facebook
item.description: The $14.99/month blue-check-adjacent subscription now also buys you the right to post URLs like it’s 2016.

item.title: Alexa finally escapes Echo speakers with a web version
item.description: The web version lets users type instead of talk, upload files for Alexa+ to analyze, and manage everyday things.

item.title: OpenAI launches app store, making ChatGPT your digital assistant
item.description: ChatGPT just leveled up with its own app store. Now, you can dive into Spotify, order from DoorDash, or manage Dropbox—all without leaving the chat.

item.title: Apple AirTags bundle drops to $65 at Amazon (limited-time only)
item.description: Amazon has dropped the price of Apple's AirTags 4-pack to $75, the lowest price available, making it an attractive offer for those looking to keep track of their keys, wallet, luggage, and more.

item.title: Meta makes billions from scam ads while users left to fend for themselves
item.description: Meta's ad revenue is set to soar, with scam and banned-product ads projected to account for a whopping 10% in 2024, translating to a staggering $1.6 billion.

item.title: Judge says Tesla misled drivers about what Autopilot actually does
item.description: A California judge just hit Tesla with a wake-up call, ruling that the company misled customers about Autopilot and Full Self-Driving. This decision led to a 30-day suspension of Tesla's sales and manufacturing.

item.title: Amazon sale drops the Ring Doorbell to $49.99 (50% off)
item.description: Upgrade your home security with the Ring Video Doorbell, now available at a clearance price of $49.99. Don't miss out on this limited-time offer!

item.title: Blink security cameras are stupid cheap right now at Amazon
item.description: Amazon is offering a Blink Outdoor 4th Gen 5-Camera System for $129.99, down from its original price of $299.99, which includes five weather-resistant cameras, two-year battery life, and works with Alexa.

item.title: How to get better tech holiday prices using simple online tools
item.description: The holiday season is upon us, and savvy shoppers are tapping into the power of online communities and AI-driven tools like Reddit, Slickdeals, Honey, Rakuten, Price.com, and ShopSavvy to revolutionize their shopping experience.
